items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Hymnlessed me one time, that if I ever do a tune on the air for a kickback, he says, I'll fire you right now.

ctx.x: And I'd set up all the broadcasting acts with him as assistants. And, uh, in fact, I used to speak to Glenn Miller on an average of two to three times a week. Finding out, you see, in those days in, in radio, network radio, they were paid a royalty fee for the compositions. And, uh, the publisher, and the publisher, and the composer was, was getting a royalty. And, uh, that was on, on, on, on, on remotes. Remotes over, remotes over, uh, uh, networks. In other words, it was CBS, NBC, and ABC. It was, actually not,…
Richard Hymnlessed was in several businesses. This is the guy you're talking about.
